one_idea.line: Yes. The auditor opening old pages and finding money or a skeleton carries both cuts, and in the short the money now comes out on 'missing money' (sofa, hold 2.3 s, play at 19.28 s = w50) and the skeleton falls just before 'skeletons' (closet, hold 0.6 s, play at 20.96 s, word at 21.30 s), so the idea's two moves land on his words. The long cut's l_sofa still plays from 'Will', 2.0 s before 'missing'.

no_invented_numbers.line: No invented figure. The held first frame of the closet clip is after the turn that hides the year-printed box, so no year the piece does not own is on screen. All four counters show only bill-billed and bill-after (195,000 and 33,000). No slam word or tape has a digit, and the figures on th_head, l_lede and l_krafton are printed on their own pages.
